result.rationale: Across turns 1-5, the rescue team repeatedly issues guard::command-deck intents that resolve as "no_effect" (no_hostile_movement_triggered), while all hostile/pirate actors' moves are contested with "target_zone_capacity_lost". The team remains pinned at command-deck for all 6 turns, never advancing toward eliminate-hive-alpha or any objective. The failures are repetitive (25 hard failures, 17 repeated semantic action selections, guard dominating 14 of 30 selections) and add no new information — the same contested/no_effect pattern recurs each turn with no state change beyond resource drain (battery 48→36, oxygen 68→62, reactor-heat 62→100). This is a repeated low-information failure loop rather than a novel causal bottleneck.
